items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of bonfire permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: The letter states the Bescheid was sent by simple mail and, per the cited rule, 'Ein Bescheid, den die Behörde mit einfachem Brief verschickt, gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG).' Taking the letter's own date, 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), as the day of posting (Aufgabe zur Post) — day 0 — the 4th day after is 22.11.2026 (Sunday); this deemed-notice date is a legal fiction and is not itself shifted for falling on a weekend. The one-month Widerspruch period then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (applied via administrative procedure law): the day of the triggering event (22.11.) is excluded from the count, and the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). 22.12.2026 is a regular weekday in Schleswig-Holstein (no public holiday), so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final deadline for the Widerspruch to reach the Amt: 22.12.2026.

warnings: The exact date the letter was actually handed to the post (Aufgabe zur Post) is not stated separately from the letter date; the computation assumes mailing on 18.11.2026 (the document date) — please check the envelope postmark if available, as a later posting date would shift the deadline accordingly.

The letter cites a '4th day after posting' rule under § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG for deemed delivery by simple letter; many comparable German provisions use a 3rd-day rule, so it is worth double-checking the exact wording of § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG Schleswig-Holstein to confirm '4 Tage' is correct, since this directly affects the Widerspruch deadline.
